meta.name: fixtures
meta.description: Guides authoring, organizing, and referencing test fixtures across the project. Use when creating new fixtures, writing tests that depend on fixtures, or deciding what should be checked into git.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理测试夹具的创建、组织和引用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常编写测试并需要管理测试数据
copy.tagline_en: Manage creation, organization, and referencing of test fixtures
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write tests and need to manage test data

howto.what: Claude 会指导你编写、组织和管理测试用的静态输入文件（如 HTML、CSS、JSON 等），确保测试可复现且不依赖外部服务。
howto.when: 当你需要创建新的测试夹具、编写依赖夹具的测试，或决定哪些文件应纳入 Git 版本控制时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个测试 CSS 属性 flexbox 的夹具文件。
这个 SVG 文件应该放在 fixtures 的哪个目录？
say.note: Claude 会根据文件类型和用途建议正确的子目录。

say.text: 检查 fixtures/local/ 下的文件是否被代码引用。
say.note: Claude 会审查代码，确保没有引用本地专用夹具。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you in authoring, organizing, and managing static input files (HTML, CSS, JSON, etc.) used as deterministic test inputs, ensuring tests are reproducible and self-contained.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to create new test fixtures, write tests that depend on fixtures, or decide what should be checked into git.

say_en.text: Create a fixture file for testing the CSS flexbox property.
say_en.note: Claude generates a minimal HTML file with only flexbox-related structure.

say_en.text: Which directory should this SVG file go in fixtures?
say_en.note: Claude suggests the correct subdirectory based on file type and purpose.

say_en.text: Check if any code references files under fixtures/local/.
say_en.note: Claude reviews code to ensure no local-only fixtures are referenced.
